slides.texte_overlay:
୨୧ pt 2
how to be less socially awkward

1. arrive a little early

small groups are easier
than walking into a full room.

2. give yourself a job

help set up, take photos, pour drinks.
you'll talk to everyone.

3. use people's names

once, naturally.
it makes every chat warmer.

4. leave on a high note

end the conversation while it's fun.
nobody remembers the awkward goodbye.

5. forgive yourself on the way home

nobody is replaying
what you said as much as you are.
which one are you trying this week?
